distsamp

Segments NARWC line-transect survey data for distance sampling and density surface models (Distance, dsm).

Input format: Kenney, R.D. (2023) The North Atlantic Right Whale Consortium Database: A Guide for Users and Contributors, Version 8. Handbook (PDF).

Install 

remotes::install_github("chross22/distsamp")

Depends on narwcr, installed automatically.

Example data 

path <- system.file("extdata", "narwc-example.csv", package = "distsamp")

Synthetic. No real NARWC records are included.

Read 

library(distsamp)
dat <- read_narwc(path)

Prepare 

dat <- prepare_survey(dat, platform = "aerial")

Builds line occupations, fills LEGSTAGE, filters by platform, flags effort.

Check 

validate_narwc(dat)
diagnose_pipeline(dat, seg_length = 5)
plot_survey(dat, "occupations")

Segment 

segs <- segment_survey(dat, seg_length = 5, seed = 1)

segs$segments     # one row per segment
segs$detections   # one row per sighting, with distance
segments_wide(segs)
plot(segs, what = "segments")

seed makes the segmentation reproducible.

Detection table 

flat <- detection_data(segs, area = 5811)   # area in km^2

Fit 

library(Distance)
fit <- ds(flat, key = "hn", convert_units = 0.001)   # m distances, km effort

Full steps to an abundance estimate: docs/11-distance-sampling-steps.md.

Shipboard surveys 

sea  <- prepare_survey(dat, platform = "vessel")
segs <- segment_survey(sea, seg_length = 10, platform = "vessel", seed = 1)
platform_defaults("vessel")

Units

Column Unit
seg_eff km
distance m (default) or km (distance_units = "km")

Other functions 

narwc_codes("LEGTYPE")            # handbook code books
filter_days(dat, years = 2024)    # subset by date
dist_methods()                    # along-track distance formulas

Citing distsamp 

citation("distsamp")

Returns the package, the segmentation method (Becker et al. 2010) and the data format (Kenney 2023). Report the seed used.
